SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
  'event_triggers', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'evtname', e.evtname,
        'evtevent', e.evtevent,
        'evtenabled', e.evtenabled,
        'evttags', e.evttags,
        'function_schema', n.nspname,
        'function_name', p.proname
      ) ORDER BY e.evtname
    )
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_event_trigger AS e
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS p ON p.oid = e.evtfoid
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'current_settings', pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'pgrst.db_schemas', pg_catalog.current_setting('pgrst.db_schemas', true),
    'pgrst.db_extra_search_path', pg_catalog.current_setting('pgrst.db_extra_search_path', true)
  ),
  'role_database_settings', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'role_name', r.rolname,
        'database_name', d.datname,
        'setting', c.setting
      ) ORDER BY r.rolname NULLS FIRST, d.datname NULLS FIRST, c.setting
    )
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_db_role_setting AS s
    LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles AS r ON r.oid = s.setrole
    LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_database AS d ON d.oid = s.setdatabase
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.unnest(s.setconfig) AS c(setting)
    WHERE pg_catalog.strpos(c.setting, 'pgrst.db_schemas=') = 1
       OR pg_catalog.strpos(c.setting, 'pgrst.db_extra_search_path=') = 1
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
) AS metadata;
